issues.detail: Main article unavailable locally. This dataset covers SI section 2 preparative networks, not section 3 optimization tables or section 4/5 unsuccessful schemes.
issues.subject: paper

issues.detail: Diol is labeled 5 in its preparation and 7 in the next two preparations. Native graphs match exactly; record 5 retains alias 7 without inventing a conversion.
Individual cyclization drawing labels the aldehyde 22 and procedure names starting 23; overview and the aldehyde graph identify 4. Products are 23a/23a-prime.
issues.subject: E25

issues.detail: Overview reports 48%; individual drawing reports 45%, and procedure gives 25% plus 20%. Individual reported yields retained.
issues.subject: E25

issues.detail: Scheme reports greater than 90%; procedure reports 80% and an inconsistent isolated mass. Dataset retains the procedure percentage without recomputing it.
issues.subject: E17

issues.detail: Several procedures use a mass/mmol pair for 6 inconsistent with its acetylated molecular formula. Native drawing and HRMS establish the recorded graph; no stoichiometric correction is inferred.
16% and 11% yields refer to the two-stage sequence from 16. Unnumbered aldehyde was isolated at 67% in the text but not drawn; no new intermediate graph is invented.
issues.subject: E18

issues.detail: TBDMS branch product 18 is reported partially racemized. Drawing depicts the positive enantiomer but is not an assertion of pure sample; ee is not calculated from optical rotation.
Small-scale optimization yields up to 83% are not substituted for the reported 70% preparative yield.
issues.subject: E23

issues.detail: Each experiment uses a diastereomeric mixture, not coupling between the two listed molecules. Both source-drawn structures are retained in a single preparation event.
issues.subject: E14/E19/E26

issues.detail: Recovered s3 at 41% is stored separately from the main iodination/deprotection path. The bracketed iodinated intermediate is drawn and retained as an operation endpoint.
issues.subject: E04

issues.detail: Multi-stage preparations without internal source drawings remain grouped. No intermediate SMILES or numerical yield is inferred.
issues.subject: E02/E05/E15

issues.detail: One HRMS spectrum measured the diastereomeric mixture. Formula agreement is not two independent stereoisomer confirmations.
issues.subject: 23a/23ap
